card_config.value: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
Add this card to your hand, or if you have the required energy, perform Raid with it.

card_set: SPECIAL BOOSTER PACK That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime [UE20BT]
card_text:
【Raid】 Switch to active. May move to the front line.
[When Played] Choose up to one site on your opponent's field and sideline it. This character gains 【Snipe】 (You may target a character on your opponent's front line and attack it with this character. If you do, your opponent cannot block) until the end of the turn.
[When Attacking] Choose one of the following:
・This character gains 【Impact (1)】 until the end of the turn.
・This character gains 【Damage (3)】 until the end of the turn.
